verdict.rationale: Netlify docs reference built-in storage capability directly relevant to persisting uploads — `getStore("file-uploads")` (Netlify Blobs) and 'Add instant databases and file storage' — showing a code-level API for storing user-generated files without external services. However, evidence is thin: no detail on durability, size limits, access control, or hands-on/independent confirmation of reliability for uploads at scale. missing for 10: deeper docs on Blobs API scope/limits, real-world usage examples, independent/community validation of the storage feature.
